task.title: Draft tailored renewal emails — Acme Corp, Brightline, Corti Labs
task.details:
Draft one tailored renewal email per account, grounded in the account situations below. Tailor tone/approach per the renewal-outreach playbook (team/playbooks/renewal-outreach.md) and the per-account briefs (team/accounts/). Emails are drafts only — do not send; @reviewer QAs before send.

Account context:
1. Acme Corp — Q3 renewal, $48k. Champion departed in May (name not on file). Risk: High (re-qualify; treat as re-sell; no assumption of renewal; ask for re-introduction meeting with new stakeholder). Lead with value recap.
2. Brightline — Q3 renewal, $22k. Usage up 40%. Risk: Low (renew + propose expansion aligned to 40% growth; multi-year option). Lead with usage win.
3. Corti Labs — Q4 renewal, $61k. Two unresolved support escalations. Risk: Medium-High (do NOT send standard renewal until escalations resolved/clear ETA; sequence support resolution first, then renewal with exec sponsor). Draft a post-resolution renewal email held until escalations clear.

Deliver: 3 email drafts (subject + body) in your task output. Flag any [NEEDS CONFIRMATION] items per briefs.
